title: Austin Housing Bond Rally Kicks Off
summary:
*   City leaders are attending a kickoff rally for a 2022 affordable housing bond campaign.
*   The event aims to build community support for future funding dedicated to increasing affordable housing options.
*   No official council votes or policy decisions will be made at this gathering.
transcript:
THE AUSTIN CITY COUNCIL WILL MEET ON THURSDAY, 
JULY 21, 2022, AT 8:30 AM, at the Learning Center at the Jordan 
at Mueller, 2724 Philomena St, Austin, TX 78723 
 
Rally 
 
8:30 - Attend a 2022 affordable housing bond campaign kickoff rally. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
A quorum of Council members may be present. No action will be taken.
